dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Hello there, distinguished guests of Lady Yae and the Almighty Shogun.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Eh? Have you seriously forgotten who I am?

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I'm Yae Publishing House's planner, the de facto organizer of the "This Novel Is Amazing!" event. We've met before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon... kinda remembers...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: That's alright, I'm sure you'll remember me after this encounter.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: After all, with this new experience, I'll be able to inject some incredible, never-before-seen creativity into Yae Publishing House's next event! I'll become a renowned planner... Ahh, I truly am spectacular!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Right, the plan is to visit as many famous spots as possible.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I hear there are quite a few scenic places inhabited by all sorts of fantastic animals here in Sumeru, where inquisitive researchers and noble Forest Rangers alike come and go, along with those mysterious, dangerous, yet alluring mercenaries.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Writers should be able to find inspiration around every corner here.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I recommended that Lady Yae bring more writers here to gather materials for their work, but she replied, "Quality is far more important than quantity," and selected Souka at random after flipping through the list.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: In truth, Souka hasn't published any successful pieces yet. But I added her to our backup roster because of her great writing skills and her ability to quickly become immersed in stories.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... so that's how Souka was selected... It does feel a little random, to be honest... But it fits Miko's style.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Maybe Miko wants to try to personally train someone new.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Wow! That's a really accurate guess!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae once said, "To discover a newcomer's potential while heading in the most interesting direction should be a unique experience."

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Now, being that senior writers mostly have their own writing style and habits, a newbie might have an advantage when it comes to incorporating foreign elements into a novel.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae is as insightful as ever! It would seem Souka really is the best candidate for the trip to Sumeru!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Mhm, you guys are more concerned with the whereabouts of Lady Yae after all.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Unfortunately, the schedule that Lady Yae put together for us only covers a few specific days. We're free to do as we wish in our free time.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Take me, for instance. I'm thrilled just looking through the details of the Beast Tamers Tournament.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: As for what Lady Yae does during her free time... Well, that's personal. It's not something a planner like me would have the privilege of knowing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, come to think of it, Miko isn't someone who would enjoy a packed itinerary.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: You too! Good luck with your competition!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: That's amazing! Have you guys studied Fungi before? You two are beyond gifted if this is your first time. I mean, you guys just easily won three matches in a row!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Haha, {NICKNAME} really does pick up things almost instantly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Miss Aratani were to join us on our adventures, you'd be able to experience all sorts of new stuff, but you'd also see that we often only have a short time to adapt to those new things!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I always thought that people like that only existed in Junkichi's outlandish novels... I see now that I was wrong!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I won't make negative comments about Junkichi's "sudden increase in power" character trope ever again!

choices.text: Let's put that aside for now... Souka...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right. Miss Aratani is here walking around... but where's Souka?

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Souka? She's feeling better. She said that she's planning the main arc of her new novel, but she still needs to find inspiration for the blanks in between the chapters...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: So she went to find a local familiar with the area and is now planning her next journey.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Souka has overcome the negative emotions of her defeat. Whew... that takes a load off our shoulders.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Isn't it the same with Miko?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Paimon hears that Miko would pound her opponents into the ground every single time! But knowing the way Miko does stuff, Paimon is sure she only showed a portion of her true power!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Here it comes — this is the part where you start buttering each other up!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Then my question would be "Then, who is the stronger one between the Traveler and Lady Yae?"

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I'm only asking about their combat skill in this competition. Assuming that the two of you were up against Lady Yae, who would win?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? How sudden! Paimon's drawing a blank...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's no good to say we don't know... but it'd be disrespectful to say that we'd beat Miko... If we were to admit defeat, we'd be too soft... How frustrating!

choices.text: There's no point in comparing combat abilities.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's right! Paimon almost let Miss Aratani trap us! Miko said herself that she was just here for the experience. All she wanted to do was to try out beast taming. There's no need for a question like that.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: What a perfect answer! The "offend no one" strategy that presses the conversation forward with no way to turn back!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Is it that obvious that you guys are the chosen "protagonists" of this world!? Hmm... I'm starting to get excited! What performances do the two of you have lined up for Souka's newest novel?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why is Miss Aratani acting so weird too? Has Souka passed her weirdness on to her...?

choices.text: What's important is that we can get along with our companions.
